notes.title: Patch #5 released
notes.content:
Hello soldiers, as requested by the community, this patch adds a new category of balanced maps. Those maps are symmetrical and each team has equal starting conditions. Therefore those maps can be used to play Hot Seat Multiplayer.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
    [*]8 new maps added
[/list]

notes.title: Patch # 3 - going out of early access
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am pleased to announce that Casus Belli is leaving Early Access.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
    [*]added 4 new maps
    [*]added automated camera movement when AI plays against itself
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]weather has smoother transition between states
    [*]various smaller bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #2 released
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this patch allows the game to be played as local multiplayer. To do this, you have to share a computer mouse, since there is no controller support. Also, it's now possible to watch the artificial intelligence playing against itself.

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
    [*]added new small size map "Dusty Cloud"
    [*]added settings to choose for each team if it is played by human or by cpu
    [*]added settings to chose starting capital
    [*]added attack animations for tank and anti air tank
    [*]added animation for destroyed vehicles (destroyed vehicles now burn and then explode, instead of just disappearing)
[/list]
